senses.gloss: (cmp. חבל) to feel oppressed; to cry; (cmp. צָוַח) to complain, bring charges.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 4:6">Yad. IV, 6</cite> <he>קוֹבְלִין אנו עליכם</he> we cry out against you (we say, ‘woe unto you’).
<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 4:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>קוֹבֵל אני עליכם</he> I accuse you.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 96:5">Gen. R. s. 96</cite> (ref. to <he>ויקרבו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 47:29">Gen. XLVII, 29</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01883"><he>קָרַב</he></cite>) <cite ref="A02060"><he>אמר</he></cite> [<he>לו</he>] <he>הקב״ה היום קובל עליך לומר בי הוא יקום</he> (not <cite ref="K00473"><he>כי</he></cite>) the Lord said to him, the day brings suit against thee (summons thee before court) saying, with me (on this day) he shall stand (before the throne of justice); Tanḥ. Vayḥi 2; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 168">Yalk. Kings 168</cite>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 9:9">Deut. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 31:14">Deut. XXXI, 14</cite> <he>הן קרבו</he>) <he>היום קבל לפני הקב״ה וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>קובל</he>) the day cried out before the Lord saying, O Lord, I will not move, I will not set, and Moses shall live; Yalk. ib. 941 <he>כאדם שאומר פלוני קובל … כך היום קובל וכ׳</he> (not <he>קיבל</he>) as one says, that man is bringing charges against thee …, so (the Lord said,) the day is summoning thee, but the sun said, I will not move &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:22">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> <he>אמו של</he> … <he>וקָבְלָה עליו לרבותינו וכ׳</he> R. Yishmael’s mother … came and complained of him before our teachers, saying &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:6">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 16:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XVI</cite> <he>הִקְבִּילָה וכ׳</he> she complained to her mistress.
